name: rkoa-vqa-benchmark
description: A visual question answering (VQA) benchmark containing image-question-answer triplets used to evaluate a model's ability to understand visual content and answer related questions. It emphasizes visual grounding and reasoning over images and is intended to measure accuracy on open-ended answers. The dataset is suitable for assessing multimodal models' competence at combining visual perception with natural language understanding.
reputation: A domain-specific VQA benchmark with limited visibility compared to major VQA datasets; mainly of interest to niche research groups.
